model.title: Layer 2 · neural model
model.note: A second, more advanced program can give an extra opinion. It downloads once (about 30 MB) and stays on your device. It mostly learned English: for other languages, the main analysis is the reference.
model.unavailableNote: Layer 2 unavailable: {reason}. Layer 1 keeps working, the tool stays complete.
privacy.title: 100% local execution — verifiable in airplane mode
privacy.body: We never see what you type or which images you open. Everything happens inside your device, like on a calculator: the result appears, nothing is sent anywhere. No account, no cookie, no tracking. The first time, the tool downloads its analysis program and keeps it: after that it works even without internet.
footnote: No detector is infallible. Formal human writing can come back as AI, and hand-edited AI text can pass as human. The score is a hint, never proof.

image.scopeBody: A signed C2PA manifest or a generator signature in the binary is evidence. Pixel analysis is not: it shows a tendency, and a crop or a re-encode erases it. Nothing leaves your browser.

legal.data.title: Personal data
legal.data.body: No data is collected, transmitted or kept. Your text and images never leave your device. No account, no cookie, no analytics, no advertising.
legal.code.title: Source code
legal.code.body: All the code is public and verifiable on GitHub. The only outbound request is the one-time download of the analysis program, then kept in your browser cache.
legal.contact.title: Contact
legal.contact.body: To report a problem, suggest a fix or contribute a translation: open an issue on GitHub or write on Discord.
stats.title: Statistics
stats.intro: These numbers are totals, not profiles. We count visits, not people: no name, no address, no history of what you analyse.
stats.privacyBody: No cookie, no identifier, no fingerprint. Your IP address is never stored: it is used once to count a unique visitor for the day, then discarded. The text and images you analyse are never measured or transmitted.
hero.answer: The short answer: nobody can state with certainty who wrote a text. This tool measures writing habits — sentence rhythm, paragraph length, repeated phrasings, invisible characters — and shows an index from 0 to 100. Everything runs in your browser: the text you analyse never leaves your device. A high score is a lead, never proof, and no one should decide on a single number.
reason.closer: Ends by offering to continue, typical of an assistant
reason.formatted: Structured answer: headings, lists and rules
jury.title: Jury · independent readings
jury.note: The verdict is a jury, not a single judge. Every reading is shown; a juror that cannot prove its reliability abstains instead of voting.
